integrity: Complete analytic proof of exact support, strict transfer, extremizer classification and fixed-r limits; independent enumerations and numerical experiments are corroboration, not substitutes for infinite proofs. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
limitations: Only unweighted complete multipartite stable-set polytopes with fixed r>=3, standard ambient Euclidean mean width, and integer positive part sizes. No result is claimed for r=2, arbitrary graphs, arbitrary weights, or a growing number of blocks. Less-indexed literature could contain related probabilistic formulations.
title: Strict mean-width majorization and multiblock Gaussian crossover for multipartite stable-set polytopes
